description: While proposing Fremont Street locations for the 2026 Amazing Race Power stations, I recommended several Las Vegas locations presented as verified facts (e.g., specific venues and attractions) that David reported do not actually exist. I also embellished details (Mega Bar claims, Fergusons Downtown courtyard, specific Golden Gate telephone artifact) without any verification source — everything was generated from training-data memory of Las Vegas geography.
correction: Real-world venue recommendations for events must be verified against a live source (web search, venue sites) before being presented as fact, or clearly flagged as unverified suggestions needing a scout check. David had to scout and discard the fabricated options himself.
systemic_fix: When a task involves real-world physical locations for an upcoming event, treat training-data knowledge as a draft only: either verify via web search before recommending, or label every location claim as 'verify on site.' Add this rule to event-planning-adjacent work.
